name: Amazon Shopping
description: Search products, add to cart, place orders, and track deliveries on Amazon.in
author: flock

requires.description: Log in to Amazon.in via the dashboard browser session to access shopping and orders
requires.rationale: Amazon has no public shopping API — a saved browser session is how the agent shops on your behalf.

read-products.reason: Searches, then opens up to 10 product pages in two rounds of 5 tabs and reads each in the page: 30-70s on a normal connection. Killed at 30s, the agent would get no cards and read the pages by hand.

networkEndpoints.purpose: Amazon.in product search and product pages
